gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kodchasan: Bold and expressive is how Pixelify Sans looks, every stroke held to one line weight. And Kodchasan, a plain sans with hanging open terminals, is what keeps the whole pairing so uncluttered.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-koho: KoHo brings wide c openings and a quiet, tidy manner beneath Pixelify Sans. KoHo stays smooth where the heading stays blocky, and body text will hold up fine at ordinary sizes.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kosugi: Pixelify Sans lays down its display letters with the same blunt, unvarying line from start to finish. But Kosugi, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c, would read through a long passage like bent wire, light and unhurried.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Chunky, playful and pixel-bent, Pixelify Sans meets Kumbh Sans, whose terminals stop well short of the bowl like marks from a fixed pen. Big, short headings are where the pixel face really counts.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-livvic: Pixel-bent heading, friendly sans-serif underneath. Make Pixelify Sans small and its paperclip-wide c loses its swagger, while Livvic, with its stress-free curves, goes happily larger without any fuss.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lunasima: Chunky pixel swagger up top, then a lighter touch below. Lunasima, a sans-serif whose c tips never creep toward touching, lets Pixelify Sans take the big, short lines.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: Pixelify Sans cuts every stroke to one line width, like sign-shop vinyl, and the result is loud and blocky. LXGW Marker Gothic reads smoothly below it, a sans with a gentle weight gradient.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Pixelify Sans draws everything with a constant stroke, a c as open as a bent paperclip. And M PLUS 1, a plain sans with big open eyes, takes over the quieter work on the page.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-metrophobic: Expressive from the first glyph, Pixelify Sans ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, which is where it does its best. But Metrophobic, a modern sans with smooth paths around each bend, does its best when the sentences get longer.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mona-sans: Pixelify Sans has a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, bold and blocky. Mona Sans, a sans-serif with openings wide as a door left ajar, gives that loudness somewhere calm to land.
